description.p: SnaPdf organizes PDFs from unrelated folders into one local workspace with nested projects, tabs, recents, search, annotations, offline OCR, Reader mode, Presentation mode, and an optional ChatGPT or Gemini study panel for questions about selected text, figures, and documents.

Documents remain in their original filesystem locations. SnaPdf does not require imports, duplicate files, or cloud storage. A provider connection is used only when the optional study panel is enabled.
New light theme with soft blue-grey surfaces, now the default. Choose Light, Dark, or Match system in Settings; PDF pages always keep their real colours.
The tab strip is taller, with its buttons centred on the tabs.

Choose how the file path is shown: the full path bar under the tabs (default) or a compact folder button in the toolbar that gives the page more room. Switch in Settings, collapse the bar with its chevron, or expand it again from the compact button. Study chat and Settings now sit at the right end of the tab strip.
Annotations saved or exported by SnaPdf now appear correctly in other PDF viewers, password-protected PDFs open after a prompt, and printing includes annotations.

Every dialog shares one centred style, the toolbar uses one consistent icon set, the project tree aligns files under their folders, secondary text is easier to read, and the Study chat has a clearer conversation switcher and a smaller default text size.
In-app updates show download progress, can be cancelled, and no longer give up on slow connections. New shortcuts: Page Up/Down, Home/End, Ctrl+0 (fit width), and Ctrl+G (go to page).
New app icon: a colourful camera shutter with a page at its centre.

Larger interface text and controls by default, a clearer split between the sidebar and the reading area, flat sidebar actions with an Add folder button when no projects exist, drawn OCR and math tool icons, a round annotation colour swatch with presets, and a single blue accent for active tools and focus.

Restyles Study chat to match the rest of the app: the same gray surfaces, flat header buttons with rename and delete always visible, a wider message column on large panels, and boxed final answers shown as soft highlighted cards.
The Overall interface-size slider in Settings now previews its value while dragging and applies it on release, instead of rescaling the Settings panel under the pointer.

Paging quickly through image-heavy PDFs no longer stalls: pages draw a quick preview first, the page being read always renders before older requests, and pages skipped while flipping are requested again when revisited.
Redesigns Settings as a centered panel with General, Appearance, and Study chat sections, toggle switches, and clearer update status.
Opening a PDF while SnaPdf is running now adds a tab to the existing window instead of starting another one.

Adopts a minimal, browser-style layout: a full-width tab strip, an address bar with the file path, and a single centered document toolbar. Ctrl+F focuses the search field immediately, and sidebar names use all of the available width.
Settings shows whether a newer release exists and can update the portable AppImage in place and restart; a prompt appears when an update is available.
Refreshes the Ubuntu/GNOME desktop icon and icon cache whenever the AppImage registers itself, including existing installations with a stale or missing icon.
Refines Study chat styling and typography, separates interface-region scaling, and keeps keyboard, wheel, and trackpad zoom focused on the PDF canvas.
Adds terminal project opening with snapdf ., improves safe in-place annotation saving and hidden recovery backups, and exports standards-compliant continuous PDF highlights across compatible viewers.
Restores native trackpad pinch-to-zoom after a desktop session switches from X11 to Wayland.
Improves Study chat with rendered equations and Markdown tables, adjustable text size and reasoning effort, a panel shortcut, and multi-file attachments. The Open dialog now supports multiple PDFs.
Polishes Study chat, adds full-document text selection and copying, compacts the document toolbar, and preserves the user's default PDF viewer.
Renames the application to SnaPdf, adds backward-compatible data migration, and introduces the lowercase snapdf package identity.
Adds the study chat, direct text and PDF-region handoff, model selection, and checksum-verified user-level installation.
